name: PCVM
author: canhphung@users.noreply.github.com
description: PCVM v1.4.0: 39 providers including real Ubuntu, Debian, AlmaLinux and Rocky Linux VMs with unprivileged QEMU TCG. No Panel/Wings modifications, KVM, inbound VM ports or arbitrary startup commands.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
install -d -m 0750 /mnt/server/.pcvm
echo '[PCVM] Control directory initialized.'

variables.name: Software
variables.description: Provider ID, or interactive for the three-level console menu.

variables.name: Software Version
variables.description: Pinned upstream version or latest.

variables.name: Software Build
variables.description: Pinned build or latest.

variables.name: Runtime Version
variables.description: auto, or a supported Java, Node.js, Python, PHP, .NET, Caddy or SteamCMD runtime line.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Resolve upstream on every start. Pinned-by-default is safer.

variables.name: Update Request
variables.description: Change this value to trigger one resolve/update.

variables.name: Accept Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Set to 1 only if you accept the Minecraft EULA.

variables.name: Reset Confirmation
variables.description: For incompatible switches, paste DELETE:<nonce> printed by the launcher.

variables.name: VM Memory
variables.description: Guest RAM in MB, or auto. The container must have at least 1536 MB and PCVM reserves at least 384 MB for QEMU/launcher.

variables.name: VM CPUs
variables.description: Guest vCPU count from 1 to 8, or auto. Cannot exceed the cgroup quota or host policy.

variables.name: VM Disk
variables.description: Sparse qcow2 disk size in GiB. Changing this after install does not shrink or replace an existing disk.

variables.name: VM Hostname
variables.description: Single-label Linux hostname used during first VM installation.

variables.name: Source Mode
variables.description: Bot source is uploaded files or a public HTTPS Git repository.

variables.name: Git URL
variables.description: Public HTTPS repository without embedded credentials.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch cloned in git source mode.

variables.name: Entry File
variables.description: Relative Node.js or Python entry file.

variables.name: App Arguments
variables.description: Arguments parsed directly into argv; no shell expansion.

variables.name: App Ready Pattern
variables.description: Optional Go regular expression which marks a bot ready.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Game server display name.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional player password. Some games impose their own minimum length.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: RCON/Telnet admin secret. When empty PCVM generates a private persistent secret.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Game server player limit.

variables.name: Game Map
variables.description: Optional map or level name; provider defaults are used when empty.

variables.name: Game World
variables.description: Save/world identity used by compatible providers.

variables.name: Game Seed
variables.description: Optional world seed where supported.

variables.name: Game Extra Arguments
variables.description: Extra argv tokens. PCVM blocks managed ports, paths and control credentials; no shell expansion.

variables.name: Steam GSLT
variables.description: Optional Game Server Login Token for providers that support it.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Required secondary allocation for Valheim and Unturned; must equal SERVER_PORT+1.

variables.name: Steam Port
variables.description: Required secondary allocation for Project Zomboid.

variables.name: Reliable Port
variables.description: Required secondary allocation for Satisfactory.

variables.name: Game Port 2
variables.description: Required secondary allocation for 7 Days to Die; must equal SERVER_PORT+1.

variables.name: Game Port 3
variables.description: Required secondary allocation for 7 Days to Die; must equal SERVER_PORT+2.

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: Loopback-only PCVM control port; this is not exposed as a public allocation.

variables.name: Telnet Port
variables.description: Loopback-only PCVM control port for 7 Days to Die.

variables.name: Web Mode
variables.description: Serve static files or reverse proxy one HTTP(S) upstream.

variables.name: Web Root
variables.description: Relative static content directory inside /home/container.

variables.name: Upstream URL
variables.description: Required in proxy mode; HTTP(S), no embedded credentials or metadata/link-local address.

variables.name: Allowed Software
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: comma-separated provider IDs.

variables.name: VM Maximum Memory
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: maximum guest RAM in MB.

variables.name: VM Maximum CPUs
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: maximum guest vCPUs.

variables.name: VM Maximum Disk
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: maximum sparse VM disk size in GiB.

variables.name: Allow User Reset
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: allow nonce-confirmed destructive switches.

variables.name: Brand Name
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: console menu brand.

variables.name: Support URL
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: optional support page.

variables.name: Runtime Mirror URL
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: optional HTTPS mirror base URL.

variables.name: Allowed Git Hosts
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: public Git HTTPS hostname allowlist.

variables.name: Runtime Cache Limit
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: runtime cache cap in MiB.

variables.name: Clear Console
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: clear terminal screen and scrollback before pcvm run output.
